fit.why: L-BFGS softmax: every iteration touches each text × class weight
per epoch ∝ texts × layer width; early stopping fixes the epoch count
linear SVM, one-vs-rest: one pass over the sparse texts per class
kernel SVM: kernel values between pairs of training texts (one-vs-one keeps it ≈ N²)

costs.note: Times measured on a shared 4-core VM with an RTX 3060 (12 GB) while other jobs ran; treat as approximate.
